content: TanStack Query + Next.js App Router: create a client Provider component (Providers.tsx, 'use client') wrapping QueryClientProvider, mounted once in app/layout.tsx. 2026 guidance: a getQueryClient() singleton per browser tab is sufficient - wrapping in useState is unnecessary. For SPA-only apps (Vite), TanStack Query owns all data fetching; for Next.js Server Components, prefer native fetch() for server-rendered reads and reserve TanStack Query for client-side interactive/authenticated flows.
